title: High hopes derrailed
text: High hopes derrailed. I had high hopes for this item.  It arrived today and I was hugely disappointed.  The photo of the embroidery on the website is different than what I received.  There are lose threads everywhere and the black flowers which are shown in the website as 'solid' black flowers are not solid at all in what I received but rather one can see the background white material throughout.  I bought it based on the beautiful photograph posted and on the fact that I wanted to support a small company called "woman's craft" which I hoped was ran by women in a developing country.  This did not mean that I wanted to throw out my money.  Sad to say that I would not recommend.

description: The term Suzani means "needlework"--specifically, the exquisite cotton thread embroidery panels made by Uzbek women. Traditionally this embroidery work began at the birth of a daughter and continued, with the help of family and friends, until the bride's dowry was complete
